--- Page 5 --- : -ai ulums t Go TALATCHENGANI Iana skang anga Ku-sikni bidingo an·tangni seanirangko bichong on-e ki-tap nakatataha.
Iano Ku-sikni bidingo ong.gija, Literature ba Sea-Jotani bidingo an-tangni seanirangko mingchikking ra-dime,"Sea-Jotani Bidingo Seanirang" ine katta bichong on-e chappa ka-attaienga.

Iano man-chapatgipa seanirang mingprakni gimin kan-dik kan-dik aganna ska: (n) "Sea-Jotanio Uie Ra-na Nanggipa Kattarang" essayo, Englisho sea-jotanio jakkalronggipa, indiba A.chikkuode a-gittalgipa kattarangni bidingo talataniko daka.
(2) Sea bewal- rokomko nitoatna aro knatoatan baksana nikjagringatna, aganani- scani bimangrangko senokgiparang jakkalronga.
Gnigipa essay "Aganani Bimangrang"-o indakgipa Aganani Bimangrangko talata.

(3) Poedo seaniosan ong-aigija gipin rokomni seanirangoba tosusae agananirangko jakkalbea, maina iaranga seaniko wa-saatan baksana, nikjagringatachitalbatatna dakchaka."A.chikku Poedorango Tosusae Agananirang"-o A.chikku poedorango jakkalgipa tosusae agananirangni bidingosan seaia.
Ia tosusae agananirangna rokomari rakgipa kattarang donga.
Indiba ua kattarangko iano jakkalja, maina ia seaniko ramram gadango uie ra-pana sikgiparangnasa miksonga.
(4) An.ching A.chikrang me-chik poedo segipakode Jonmoni D.
Shirakosan uitokpaaia.
Indiba gipin gipin poedo sena changgipa A.chik me-chikrang gnang.
Uamangni poedorang Jonmoni D.
Shirani seanirangkoba nikchangskanade manja.
Ia scanio uamangni on-gilaniko ra.chaka aro niksengata.
Iamangni ja-mano poedo segiparangko iano man.chapja.
(5)"A.chikku Romantic Poetry", ian ruuta bilsirangna skang segipasa.
Ia seanio'romantic poetry'-ni gimin on-tisa talatchenge, ia dolo ga-akgipa A-chikku poedorangko nia.
(6) "Kan-dikgipa Golporang" essayo, mai rokom seaniko short story ba Kan-dikgipa Golpo ine sea-jotanio minga, uko talatna jotton ka-a.
Golpoko kan-dike seaiode, uno Kan.dikgipa Golponi gunrang dongjaode, uko Kan.dikgipa Golpo ine aganna man.ja.
Kan.dikgipa Golponi gunrangko ia seanio talata.
(7) Snigipa essayara “Kabe".
Kabe- --- Page 6 --- ni mangsongani, manggrapani rokom-bewal, katta bichong aro uarang gitako ia essayo nia.
(8) “Dakmesokani"- ian chetgipa essay.
"Drama" seani bidingo uie ra-na nanggnirangko iano talata.
(9) "Dakmesokaniko Senokgipani Gunrang" essayo, Dakmesokaniko chu-sokgipa ong-atna maironga changa-sapanirangko nanga aro mai chol-bewalrangko senokgiparang jakkala, uarangko talata.

(1o) Bon-kamgipa essay "Chap Dilmong Ge-sangipa aro Chasong Gitalni Dakmesokanirang"-o One-Act Playni gunrang aro Chasong Gitalni Dakmesokanirangko, A.chikkuo segimin Dakmesokanirangko ra-chape, talataniko daka.
Sea-jotani bidingo skie-poraie ra-enggiparangsan ong-aigija, rakkibaenggipa A.chikrangni ring-ani-minganirang, Katta Agananirang A.chik mandeko mandeskaming kabinge dona.
Uni gimin ning-tue apale ong.jaoba, A.chikkuo sea-jotani bidingo kosakgilgilde an-ching pilakan uie ra-na nangchongmota.
Ia seanirangko dakmitingo anga A.chik Poedorang, A.chik Dakmesokanirang, Milton S.
Sangmani "History of Garo Literature" aro “History and Culture of the Garos", B.Datta, N.C.
Sharma aro P.C.Dasni"A Handbook of Folklore Material of North East",Mihir N.Sangmani"Maniani Bidik"aro"PagitchamniKu-bisring",Aldrich Ch.
Mominni"A.chikni Ku-andik" aro Harendra W.
Marakni"A-chik Aganbewalrang"-ko nirongaha aro jakkalaha.Iarang baksana, angni jakkalgipa gipin ki-taprangara Michael Meyerni "The Bedford Introduction To Literature" (Second Edition), Lee A.
Jacobusni"The Bedford Introduction To Drama" aro William Henry Hudsonni"An Introduction To The Study of Literature".
"Kabe"-ni gimin semitingo anga talbate ra•na gita, Miksakgre songchi re-ange Pa Agat A.
Sangmako grongea aro ua angna aditakon taldapate on-aha.
Iako semitingo, anga angni Cotton Collegeo English Honours ra-e poraiako gisik ra-ata.
Angni porairimska saksa, Indiani senokgiparangni bidingo aganchapmitingo, Shri Rabindranath Tagore, ine janapa.
Chingni Skigipa ka-dingnapbeaha.
--- Page 7 --- Shakespeare, Mr.
Wordsworth, Mrs.
Elizabeth Browning ine seako na-a banoba nikama?
Iamangko mandena mande raja, uamangni namnambegipa seanirangnasa.
Manderang siahaoba, uamangko Late Shakespeare ine seja, maina uamangni seanirang pangkama aro janggi tangkama.
Uamangni seanirangko talatmitingode, man-a dipet Present Tenseko (Da-o Ong-gipa Tense) jakkalna nanga.
Ian Literatureni rokom-bewal", ine ua talataha.
Uni kattarangko gisik ra-e, anga indinari janapanio Pa, Ma inaniko jakkaloba, senokgiparangni kamrangni bidingo talatmitingode, Da-o Ong.gipa Tenseko jakkale sena jotton ka-a.
Uni gimin iano Pa, Ma ine segijaniara mande ra.gjaniko mesokani ongja; sea-jotani pangkamaniko mesoknasa ong-a.
Pa Keneth M.
Momin Achikku sea-jotanina gisik nangchongmotgipa ong-a.
Ua adita ki-taprangko see uarangko chappa dakchakpachina phoneosa mol.molataiaha.
Angni seanina "Agansoani"-ko sena phonechisa mol-molahaomangba, ua ki-tapna mikkimko on-anina anga Pa Keneth M.
Mominko mittelbea.
Dated, Tura, Brucellish K.
Sangma 2nd December, 2005 (Renangma) ii --- Page 8 --- AGANPAANI KATTARANG A.chik ku-siko sea-jotanirang, gipin jatrang baksa tosusaode namen komibe-engkua ine da-alona kingkingba aganna man-a.
Una bateba A-chikni sea-jotani bidingo sandie, chanchibewale seanirangde ki-taprangko A.chik chanchibewalrakgipa manderang nakatatgnok, gisiktango nisengsoe dongengachim.

Segiminrangni gimin ning·tue chanchie, seani bewalrangni gimin u.i-ma.sie, segiparangni chanchiani bidingrangni gimin chanchibewalskae uamangni miksongani, gisikna mesokania maikai rokom rokom chanchianirangko, ma·sianirangko manderangni ka-tongo nabaata Unon pringsao Ma.
Sangma an-tangni segimin ki-tapna "Sea- jotani Pidingo Seanirang"-na talatchenganiko see on-pachina tele- phone ka-e ango molmolaha aro uni segiminko ki-tap dakna tarigiminko angona watataha.
Uni segimin ki-tapko poraie nion angni sintie, nichaksoe dongenganina Nokgipa angna aganchakaha gita anga chanchimanpila.
Gipin segimin A.chikni sea-jotani bidingo segiminrangna bate Ma.
Sangma namen A.chik ku-siko segimin aro chapa ka-gimin ki-taprangko sandirikkote seaniko anga chagrongaha.
Sangma an-tangan English Literatureko skie ragipa aro Tura Government Collegeo bang-a bilsirangna skie on:gipa taridape nambegipa ki-tapko dakna cholko ra-aha.
Ia ki-tapo A.chikkuo segimin bang-a chanchibewale seanirang, namnamgipa poedorang (Ku-minchi), dakmesokanirang, Donmitape seanirang aro ring-ringanirang, ma.ringanirangni gimin Ma.
K Sangmani sandianiko aro ma-sisokaniko aro una agreba gital gital nikanirangko aro chanchianirangko niksoe anga an-tangba bang.a ma-sidapanirangko man-aha.
Sangma indakgipa ki-tapko sena ru-uta bilsirangko ra.e chanchibewalna, chanchirikkotna aro uarangko sea-jotani bimangona iv --- Page 9 --- ra-bana gita neng-bee kam kaaha ine ia ki-tapan sakki on-a.
Uni sandie nikgiminrangko seskaaniko poraie nie anga aiao inmanpila.
A.ningodonggipa gamrangnigimin ramram songdongpaaigiparangde maiko u-ipaa?
Indiba uarangko sandigiparangsa, gisik a-ning bite ma-sigiparangsa banoniko maikai aro uarangko maikai am-e nikna man-gen uamangsa u-ia.

Indiba basakoba atchu-ambini tangka gope dongipako, darangni u-igijao donggenchimoba, maibakai a-a cho.mitingo chagaka gita aro uko nikgipana bang-a pattianiko on-a gita A.chikni sea-jotani bidingo bang-bea gitalgipa gamrangko, mingsinggipa ro.ongrangko, gisikni gamna ia ki-tapo nikna man-a.
Ia ki-tapo Ma.

Sangma an-chingni katta jakkalanirang, ku.minchi ong.chong, ku-akma ong.chong ba je rokom seanichiba chanchianiko parakatani ong.chong, uarangni rokom aro bewalko sandirikkite uarangni bilsuanirangko an-chingna parake on-aha.
Indakgipa ki-tapkosa A.chik poraigiparangna, mongsongbate College aro Universityo poraienggiparangna, namen nangbeenga.

Uni gimin ia ki.tap jakkaltobegipasan ong-aijawa, indiba indake sandirikkite, chanchibewale, gital gital nika-nianirangko niknakgipa Ia ki-tapko A.chik jinmarangba poraie nie bang.bea u-idapani- rangko man.gen aro gisikni apaldapaniko ong-atgen ine anga ka.donga.
gimin ia ki-tapko mande ra-na "Aganpaani Kattarang"-kosa sena anga namnikaha.
Sangma indakgipa namgipa, gamchatgipa seanirangko mikkangchiba ong.katatkugen ine anga ka-donga aro indakachin jatna dal-bea dakchakaniko on.gilpagen.
